test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2225a2eaadc15e5a570856b58a9c4b211823ca0ff70a811ff879739530a4842b.png] 

Option 1) WT-XZ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c066c76a3834c4c10540dec65165a97ef9916a1949b4a859cafc00c650bd6538.png] 

Option 2) RO-SV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb2dd6b1d6df18aa0dfacf4f2a99ac386f32a5ee274b3227b5bfff456fee47ab.png] 

Option 3) NK-OQ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/801e256bed970e35fae16d3cb244b7a0f9b3fcf7266d98a195879f9dc7637847.png] 

Option 4) UR-VX 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4096d7897cdaabbae68c2b41863354ea60423496e87e7f1d628a7c35e2efa5e3.png] 

So, 'RO-SV ' letter-cluster does not belong to that group.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
